question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Punishment**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Punishment **means a penalty inflicted for wrongdoing or a violation of rules, intended to deter or correct behaviour. (गलत कार्य या नियमों के उल्लंघन के लिए दिया गया दंड, जिसका उद्देश्य व्यवहार को रोकना या सही करना है)

 
 
• **Example: **The teacher gave detention as a punishment for the student's disruptive behaviour in class.
 
 
 
• "**punishment**" is the appropriate word for the blank as it conveys the idea that speed maniacs often evade the legal consequences of their actions, creating a sense of impunity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Luxury: **High-quality living, often associated with comfort, elegance, and abundance. (उच्च गुणवत्ता वाला जीवन, अक्सर आराम, सुंदरता और प्रचुरता से जुड़ा होता है)
 
• **Notice: **To observe or become aware of something, often through formal communication. (किसी चीज़ का निरीक्षण करना या उसके प्रति जागरूक होना, अक्सर औपचारिक संचार के माध्यम से)
 
• **Limit: **A point or restriction indicating the boundary beyond which something cannot extend or exceed. (सीमा को इंगित करने वाला एक बिंदु या प्रतिबंध जिसके आगे कोई चीज़ बढ़ या बढ़ नहीं सकती)
